note_en: 与其 A，不如 B means "rather than A, better B": 与其 goes before the rejected option, 不如 before the chosen one. In the text: 与其拼命加班却买不起房，不如先把日子过得简单一点 "rather than work herself to the bone and still not afford an apartment, better to live a simpler life for now"; 与其在外面躺着，不如回家躺 "rather than lie flat out there, come home and lie flat." The variant 与其说 A，不如说 B means "it's less A than B": 与其说我在躺平，不如说我在换一种姿势走路 "I'm not so much lying flat as walking in a different way."
